GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 3rd rail 2 Lengths 1200m 3rd 3 Lengths 800m 3rd 3 Lengths home turn 3rd weakened final 250m # every ch/tired 250m
Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 5 lengths. moved up Wide turn 3 lengths. weakened # Every Chance

Jumped only fairly then hampered 1 length or So and Settled Down equal last 11 Lengths from the lead, railed up to 7.5 Lengths still running last at the turn, Hooked Out Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # hampered at start
Slow out then hampered (-2 lengths) and Settled Down 9 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 11 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # very slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin and hampered shortly after, losing ground (~2L).

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: (was kicked behind barriers. passed fit) jumped fine. Settled Down 9th Inside 7 Lengths @ 1000m. Saved Ground railing into Straight . all Clear Straightening Up and Same all way to line, into 3rd final 75m # ran on soundly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the mare, which was kicked behind the barriers, passed it fit to race. Slow to begin.
